title: Oracle Core Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
Oracle Core Database Administrator (DBA)

**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Work Mode:** Onsite  
**Experience:** 3–9 Years  
**Compensation:** ₹6 LPA – ₹18 LPA  
**Employment:** Full\-Time  
**Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners / Up to 10 Days

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced **Oracle Core Database Administrator (DBA)** to manage, maintain, optimize, and support enterprise Oracle database environments. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with Oracle database administration, high availability, backup and recovery, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.

Key Responsibilities

* Administer and maintain Oracle database environments in enterprise setups.
* Manage database instances, users, roles, privileges, and security configurations.
* Perform database backup, recovery, cloning, and restoration using **RMAN**.
* Execute point\-in\-time recovery and support disaster recovery activities.
* Monitor database performance and troubleshoot performance\-related issues.
* Analyze slow\-running queries and optimize SQL execution plans.
* Manage Oracle **RAC** and **ASM** environments.
* Support database patching, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
* Analyze alert logs, trace files, and database errors to resolve technical issues.
* Provide operational and production database support as required.

Required Skills

* 3–9 years of hands\-on experience as an **Oracle Core DBA**.
* Strong experience with **Oracle RAC, ASM, RMAN, and Data Guard**.
* Good knowledge of Oracle database backup and recovery.
* Strong understanding of database performance tuning and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Oracle database patching and upgrades.
* Good knowledge of **Linux/Unix** operating systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work effectively in an enterprise database environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated resume highlighting relevant Oracle DBA experience.

Email \- jitu@medhbs.com  
WhatsApp \- 8709894784

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Oracle Core Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
**JD\-Oracle Core Database Administrator (DBA)**

**Location: Gurgaon (5days WFO)**

**Experience Required: 2\-12yrs**

**Shift: Rotational(24x7x365 support)**

**Database**

* End to End DB monitoring on the environment (approx. 400 Instances)
* Oracle Database Patches Review and Installation
* Raise an SR and respond to Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents
* Perform triage and troubleshooting of incidents described in SRs.
* Address resolution of Problems and Provide workarounds to restore services and maintain the SLA
* Perform sanity check on the Databases
* propose the Action plan: For changes executed by oracle DBA team for all other changes:
* Support Customer in analysis of any Plans of Action (PoA) provided by Customer before execution by customer.
* Provide inputs to customer to help identify plan risks and issues.
* Make recommendations to the plans based on Oracle’s best practices.
* Assist users in creating a mutually acceptable plan with mitigation plans for identified risks if required
* Ongoing Analysis of DB performance
* Weekly review of alerts
* DB purging and Archival (Customer shall provide the logic)
* Assist Customer with capacity planning on yearly basis
* Support in resolving backup related issues\-
* Need based assistance on database restoration and recovery
* Track Production server utilization using OS utilities
* Identify hogging database sessions as reported by You
* Perform cleanup of stray Oracle processes
* Troubleshooting of performance issues by analyzing Automatic Workload Repository (AWR) and session events.
* Provide Standby creation
* Apply Database dot release update (version upgrade is excluded)
* Disk addition in Automatic Storage Management (ASM) database
* Gathering Logs
* Archive Log management
* Check database invalid dictionary objects
* Database initialization parameter changes on need basis
* Troubleshooting Locks and Latches
* Review Transparent Network Substrate (TNS) entries settings on need basis.
* Performance Tuning for Reports for CBS
* Following activities would be included:
* Analysis of current reports and query run times
* Review and identification of performance bottlenecks
* Provide recommendations for performance tuning
* Implementation of tuning recommendations under the purview of Oracle
* Implementation of DB Recommendations
* Implement DB recommendations. This excludes any recommendation that requires any third\-party product and/or service and procurement of Oracle/non\-Oracle additional
* licenses and/or hardware. Oracle shall not be responsible for delay on part of your IT team implementing such recommendations.
* Maintaining Database availability and Standby database syncing under SLA
* Making sure of no Application Service interruption due to db site issues like tablespace and mount point utilization

**Oracle Database Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) Support:**

* Check AVDF Server Status and Health
* Running Diagnostics Checks for the Audit Vault Server
* Support Issues on AVDF reports
* Provide recommendations for Scaling of Hardware / Space
* Register Hosts/Agent/Targets/Enforcement Points in the Audit Vault Server for AVDF Supported Databases

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Must have 2\+yrs exp in Oracle DBA
* Notice Period
* Expected CTC
* Willing to work in rotational shift\-24x7x365 support

title: Faculty Head
description:
Job Description: Service Coordinator (Education Sector)

**Location:** Indirapuram, Ghaziabad

Position Summary

The Service Coordinator in the education sector is responsible for facilitating effective communication between parents and the educational institution, ensuring a seamless counseling experience for prospective students and their families. This role involves coordinating and assigning candidates, addressing inquiries, and supporting the overall enrollment process.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Counseling and Support

* **Engage with Parents:**
* Provide information and guidance to parents regarding educational programs and services.
* Address queries and concerns through in\-person meetings, phone calls, and emails.
* **Conduct Assessments:**
* Assess the needs and preferences of families to recommend suitable educational pathways for their children.

2\. Coordination and Administration

* **Candidate Assignment:**
* Coordinate the assignment of candidates to appropriate educational programs based on their needs and interests.
* Maintain a database of candidates and track their progress through the enrollment process.
* **Schedule Appointments:**
* Organize and manage counseling sessions and meetings with parents and prospective students.
* Ensure that all appointments are well\-coordinated and that all relevant materials are prepared in advance.

3\. Collaboration

* **Work with Educational Staff:**
* Collaborate with teachers, administrators, and counselors to align services with student needs.
* Communicate any specific requirements or concerns raised by parents to the appropriate educational personnel.

4\. Documentation and Reporting

* **Maintain Records:**
* Keep accurate records of counseling sessions, communications with parents, and candidate assignments.
* Generate reports on enrollment statistics and feedback for management.

5\. Continuous Improvement

* **Feedback Collection:**
* Gather feedback from parents and candidates to improve counseling services and educational offerings.
* Participate in training and professional development to enhance counseling skills and knowledge.

Qualifications

* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* **Experience:**
* Previous experience in counseling, educational coordination, or customer service, preferably within the education sector.
* **Skills:**
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build rapport with parents and students.
* Organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with CRM software.

Key Competencies

* **Empathy:** Ability to understand and relate to the concerns of parents and students.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Proactive in identifying issues and finding effective solutions.
* **Team Player:** Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and educational staff.

Work Environment

* This position will be based in Ghaziabad, requiring occasional travel to local schools and events as necessary.

To apply, connect with us at: **8929412164**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you fluent and confident in spoken English, especially while speaking with parents and students?
* Do you have experience in counseling, customer service, parent handling, or student coordination?
* Are you comfortable working from our Indirapuram, Ghaziabad office and following the given work timings?

title: Enterprise SaaS Product Specialist - Demos & Customer Solutions (Gurgaon, India)
description:
Title
  

Enterprise SaaS Product Specialist \- Demos \& Customer Solutions


Job ID
  

\#JOL\-SLE\-IN\-090126


**Location**
  

Gurgaon, Haryana, India


**Company**
  

Jolly Technologies Inc.  

  



**Summary**
  

Jolly Technologies is a Silicon Valley\-based software company with more than 40,000 customers and millions of users, including many Fortune 500 companies and other world\-renowned organizations.


Our products include **Eventleaf** and **Lobbytrack**, enterprise SaaS platforms used by organizations with demanding business and operational requirements.


We are looking for an articulate, technically comfortable person who can learn sophisticated SaaS products quickly and explain them clearly to business customers. The primary responsibility is to conduct online product demonstrations for prospective customers, understand their requirements, and show how our products can meet those requirements.


This is a remote, work\-from\-home contract position for candidates based in India.


**Responsibilities**
  

* Conduct online demonstrations of Eventleaf and Lobbytrack for prospective customers
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate relevant product capabilities
* Answer product questions from prospective and existing customers by email and during calls
* Provide initial product guidance and setup assistance when appropriate
* Document product issues and communicate them to the appropriate internal team
* Work closely with sales and product teams to help customers understand our software
**Requirements**
  

* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Comfortable demonstrating software to business and enterprise customers over Zoom
* Able to understand customer requirements and explain software capabilities clearly
* Technically comfortable and able to learn complex SaaS applications quickly
* Strong written communication skills for customer correspondence
* Professional, organized, self\-motivated, and customer\-focused
* Experience with SaaS, enterprise software, software training, inside sales, or a similar role is preferred
* Strong references from previous managers/supervisors
**Important**
  

This is a product\-focused customer\-facing position, not a software engineering or solutions architecture role. You do not need to be a programmer or database administrator. We are looking for someone who can learn our products, communicate confidently with business customers, and give effective software demonstrations.


**Compensation**
  

₹30,00,000 \- ₹45,00,000 per year (commensurate with experience)


**Application Process**
  

* Reply with your resume including education details in PDF or Word format to **jobs.2026 @ jollytech.com** with the subject “JOL\-SLE\-IN\-090126”
* Include your desired salary
* Include 3\-5 bulleted points listing your top strengths and measurable achievements (please be concise)

About the Role:


The Team:


The solutions Operations division is seeking a professional with excellent interpersonal communication, organization, and time management skills to join our Global Special Services Team. S\&P’s WSO (Wall Street Office) provides real\-time access to our client’s portfolio and reporting insights for active asset management and deal administration, trading activities, cash and position level transparency and accurate P\&L reporting. Underpinned by our WSO Administrator and WSO Agent product suites, WSO supports complex aspects of alternatives asset management in a scalable solution that increases operational efficiency while reducing risk. Our solutions are available as a hosted software or a fully outsourced managed service.


Responsibilities and Impact:


You will work within a dynamic team, responsible for all client\-facing operations\-related items, data research, and processing functions on the Special Services Team which primarily supports WSO users and their loan processing needs. In this position, you will gain exposure to an exciting financial market and interact daily with our clients of varying levels of seniority. This is an exciting opportunity to learn about finance, banking, the syndicated loan market, and Software as a Service (SAAS) technology.


* As a Specialized Account Services Analyst, you are expected to support our clients and the business orchestrating workflow and prompt resolution between internal and external teams. This includes dealing with data reconciliation and validation of trades and positions to ensure syndicated facility data integrity.


	+ These tasks include but are not limited to:
	
	
		- Accurately reviewing and maintaining asset and contract data
		- Hand\-holding new deal creation and data point accuracy
		- Processing amendments, investigating discrepancies, and processing
		- Monitoring and actioning exceptions
		- Additional syndication loan maintenance
* Strict adherence to processing deadlines, quality\-controlled operational processes, and LSTA/LMA/Private Deals/Middle Market standards for processing loan transactions and/or trades.
* Data Management and Controls


	+ Review source documents and files ensuring information is complete prior to entry into database
	+ Updating and entering records with a high degree of accuracy ensuring compliance with business procedures
	+ Verifying completeness, accuracy and consistency of information by conducting quality assurance audits identifying missing, incorrect, or conflicting information while ensuring any inconsistencies are corrected in an expedited manner
	+ Support reoccurring audits and compliance checks of multi\-database records
* You will be responsible for proactively identifying internal and external processing and system\-related issues effectively. This will also require the ability to work seamlessly with internal partners and management on resolution plans and/or additional escalations.
* Lead research and projects on cross\-product integrations, and workflow enhancement to support the client’s business requirements and strategic growth. This includes direct client engagement, project management, and presentation coordination where necessary.
* Serve as subject matter expert for all Solutions products and service offerings, able to join internal and external client meetings or calls to analyze client needs and make recommendations on operational flows and product usage. Contribute presentation materials where necessary.
* Your ability to capture and channel user feedback through proper communication and listening skills is imperative. You will be required to partner with leaders, peers, product associates, sales, and relationship managers on required projects to service our clients and facilitate the continuous improvement of our products and services.
* Aid all team members with daily project management, data validation, and data deliverables as needed.
* You should be willing to cross\-train with neighboring divisions of the firm to provide an agile workforce capable of handling issues and engaging with joint clients.

What We’re Looking For:


Basic Required Qualifications:


* 1 \- 3 years of work experience within the financial and/or syndicated loan industry
* Working hours: US shift
* Must be able to handle stressful customer situations with patience and poise
* Ability to organize and prioritize complex issues and projects to completion
* Able to demonstrate knowledge and experience in working with internet\-based applications
* Ability to think laterally, provide proper issue analyses, and question current processes
* Eager to learn with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Proficient PC skills, especially in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Strong process improvement skills
* Positive, proactive attitude and ability to work well in teams
* Fluent English speaking, reading, and writing abilities
* Exceptional skills in listening to clients, articulating ideas and complex information in a clear and concise manner
* Proven record of maintaining strong relationships with senior members of client organizations, addressing their needs, and maintaining a high level of client satisfaction
* Goal and action\-orientated, with the ability to organize, multi\-task, and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to manage projects independently when required

* WSO and/or Loan IQ Experience
